<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Water Scamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2988)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Water scamps are marked apart from other scamps by sleek fur that traps a layer of water next to their skin. Although they can fly like their kin and conjure enough water to never dry out, water scamps leave the water only when they must. Although air-breathing scholars consider these scamps quiet and rather skittish, underwater civilizations find their exuberance and playfulness can be overwhelming.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Water Scamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2988)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=587" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=732" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 147

**Perception** +3; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +6, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +6

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +3

**Con** +1

**Int** -2

**Wis** +0

**Cha** +0
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +7 

**Ref** +11 

**Will** +4 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20
([fast healing 2](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=62) (while underwater))

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696)

**Resistances**
[acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524) 3, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) 3

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, fly 25 feet, swim 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +8 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d6+1 slashing

**Arcane Innate Spells** DC 17, attack +9
- **1st**
[Create Water](/Spells.aspx?ID=53)
- **2nd**
[Acid Grip](/Spells.aspx?ID=1436)

**Acid Breath** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3), [Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11)) The water scamp breathes acid in a 15-foot cone that deals 2d6 acid damage to each creature within the area (DC 17 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The water scamp can't use Acid Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

**Drench** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) The water scamp shakes out a seemingly endless supply of water from its fur to put out all fires in a 5-foot emanation. The scamp extinguishes all non-magical fires automatically and attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) magical fires (+7 counteract modifier).

</column>
